PRE-TECHNICAL STUDIES — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #18
====

GRADE: Grade 9
SUBJECT: PRE-TECHNICAL STUDIES
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When learning Driving Tools, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Driving Tools.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Driving Tools.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Driving Tools.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Driving Tools.

2. When learning Wood 8 3.2 Handling Waste Materials 8 4.0. Tools and Production 4.1 Holding Tool, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Wood 8 3.2 Handling Waste Materials 8 4.0. Tools and Production 4.1 Holding Tool.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Wood 8 3.2 Handling Waste Materials 8 4.0. Tools and Production 4.1 Holding Tool.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Wood 8 3.2 Handling Waste Materials 8 4.0. Tools and Production 4.1 Holding Tool.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Wood 8 3.2 Handling Waste Materials 8 4.0. Tools and Production 4.1 Holding Tool.

3. Electricity safety rule: (1 mark)
   A. Overload every socket
   B. Insert metal objects into sockets for fun
   C. Never touch live wires with wet hands
   D. Ignore burnt cables

4. When learning Oblique Projection, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Oblique Projection.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Oblique Projection.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Oblique Projection.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Oblique Projection.

5. When learning Holding Tools, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Holding Tools.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Holding Tools.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Holding Tools.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Holding Tools.

6. ICT stands for: (1 mark)
   A. Internal Cooking Timer
   B. International Cricket Team
   C. Information and Communication Technology
   D. Input Cable Tester

7. A computer’s main brain for processing is the: (1 mark)
   A. Keyboard
   B. Monitor
   C. Speaker
   D. CPU

8. Before using a sharp tool in a workshop, you should: (1 mark)
   A. Remove all guards
   B. Run with the tool
   C. Wear safety gear and follow instructions
   D. Work alone with eyes closed

9. When learning Handling Hazardous Substances, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Handling Hazardous Substances.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Handling Hazardous Substances.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Handling Hazardous Substances.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Handling Hazardous Substances.

10. When learning Handling Waste Materials, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Handling Waste Materials.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Handling Waste Materials.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Handling Waste Materials.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Handling Waste Materials.

11. When learning Safety on Raised Platforms, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Safety on Raised Platforms.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Safety on Raised Platforms.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Safety on Raised Platforms.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Safety on Raised Platforms.

12. When learning Self- Exploration and Career Development, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Self- Exploration and Career Development.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Self- Exploration and Career Development.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Self- Exploration and Career Development.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Self- Exploration and Career Development.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Project and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Financial Services 4 5.2 Government and Business 6 5.3 Business Plan 6 Total Num and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Financial Services and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Government and Business and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
